heron_down.speaker: narrator
heron_down.text: The heron folded down into the reeds, and lay flat, and was only a sheet of wet paper with a bird printed faintly in it.

heron_down.speaker: patch
heron_down.text: You saw. You were right there in the reeds and you saw her go under, and you just stood there.

heron_down.speaker: narrator
heron_down.text: The ink round the nest went still, and then, for the first time since the flood, it began to drain.
